title: Take your Claude skills from beginner to pro for just $15
excerpt: Unlock more of Claude’s potential with this four-course E-Degree.
content_html:
TL;DR: Learn to master one of the buzziest AI models on the market with this Claude AI Professional E-Degree, now just $14.97 (reg. $159) through Aug. 25.

Credit: Eduonix Learning Solutions

$14.97
$159 Save $144.03

If Claude is your go-to AI model, you’re probably underusing it. This powerful tool is becoming a favorite for a reason, and now it’s easier than ever to use its full power to your advantage. This Claude AI Professional E-Degree teaches you the tools, techniques, and skills to help you get more out of this AI model for only $14.97 now through Aug. 25.

Sure, you can ask Claude a question and get an answer in seconds, but there’s so much more that this AI model can do for you. The Claude AI Professional E-Degree shows you how to really put this powerful tool to the test, teaching you how to use it like a pro.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Go from a beginner to an expert user with the four info-packed courses that cover four Claude tools in the E-Degree. Eduonix Learning Solutions, a team of industry professionals, walks you through more than eight hours of content, schooling you on the ins and outs of Claude — from building effective prompts to building a website.

Mashable Trend Report

Let these instructors show you how to set up an automated system, create practical projects for marketing workflows, or learn more complex tasks, like mastering chain-of-thought workflows that improve your Claude answers.

Discover how to connect Claude to Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Chrome, MCP connectors, and productivity tools. If you’re coding, you can also master AI-assisted coding workflows and debugging techniques available to you.

Once you work through the courses, you can test your skills with quizzes. You can also receive a professional eDegree certification upon completion.

Score this Claude AI Professional E-Degree for just $14.97 now through Aug. 25.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
